name: Elg
author: hundekraft
description: Elg is Norwegian for moose, and every note is a moose call. A low, growling voice opens its throat from "oo" towards a wider vowel while the pitch scoops up and sags. A chest resonance, a breath of air and a sub sit under it. Each voice calls again on its own every few seconds, so a held chord turns into a herd calling across a frozen lake. orange brings in a slow aurora pad behind the animal: three saws whose two bright bands drift like curtains of light.
